objective: Month-by-month accounting of author selection-set differences and inferred month-end entries/exits; not model fitting or performance search.
secondary: replace risk denominator/window one at a time
fixed industry-relative substitute for state correction
inputs: Only cached source-hashed prices, author supplied simulated period holdings and prior rank reconstructions. All features through signal close; next-month returns not used to select or explain ranks.
matching: Author holdings are unordered sets, not published rank1-3. Pairwise differences only compare missed author choices with our selected outsiders.
exit: Infer full removals from adjacent sets; partial trims and actual stop reasons cannot be recovered from a holdings list. No daily stops inferred.
correction_bound: Diagnostic optimistic additive correction w*z, z in [-0.5,0.5], pairwise score gap<=w; not author ML reconstruction or probability.
protections: No rule fitting, returns optimization, ledger edits, plan edits, automation or existing code changes.
